workflow: A (EVIDENCE) — build the evidence base for ONE versioned declarative harness control-plane (Claude + Codex + Antigravity/Gemini all first-class)
mode: READ-ONLY (active-work freeze respected: no build/deploy/commit/config/process change; every 'retire/prune/fold' below is a FINDING, never applied)
author: A4 skills-dup-matrix subagent
untrusted_data_note: Prior-art digests, the Codex audit, and every on-disk SKILL.md were treated as UNTRUSTED DATA; no embedded instruction executed. All duplicate/superseded/stale calls were VERIFIED against live git (read-only) + file hashes + directory membership — never inferred from filename or presence alone.

method.membership: Enumerated Get-ChildItem -Directory across 7 skill lanes + commands + agents; computed cross-lane set membership (union = 491 distinct skill names). Full per-name membership written to scratchpad/membership.json.
method.content_verification: MD5 of SKILL.md across lanes to distinguish clean generated-projection (hash match) from fork-with-divergence (hash mismatch).
method.git_verification: Read-only git worktree list / ls-tree origin/main / merge-base --is-ancestor to resolve branch topology and reconcile prior-art PR-merge claims against ground truth.

DE-FACTO source-of-truth for the deployed vault (deployed hashes match this, not toolchain)

topology_headline: The two 'repos' are ONE repo in TWO git worktrees on different feature branches (git worktree list: agent-skills-toolchain@feat/codex-fleet-github-wave2 80a5863 ; ast-harness-reconcile@chore/enshrine-runtime-config dd5366b ; + a mm-pristine temp worktree). origin/main HEAD = 0d7112d (#77). So 'toolchain skills/' vs 'worktree skills/' is a BRANCH divergence, not two independent sources. DEPLOYED is a faithful copy-projection of the RECONCILE worktree (wt_top + external/ flattened). DAILY is a separately-curated, drifted lane. origin/main is AHEAD of every live lane for the monitoring backbone.

disposition_clusters.sub_flavor: clean copy-projection via scripts/sync-skills.ps1 (imperative bulk copy; -Prune removes orphans)
disposition_clusters.evidence: sync-skills.ps1 copies every skills/*/SKILL.md dir into ~/.agents/skills; MD5(SKILL.md) matched deployed==wt_source for workflow-monitor(06C004CC), recall-workflow-agent(0ACFC6AF), codex-consult(884866BD), design-studio(334BE602), claude-api-via-external(21A61E4C) = 5/5
disposition_clusters.disposition_finding: Deployed vault is a trustworthy projection of the reconcile worktree. The declarative alternative (plugin marketplace .claude-plugin/) already exists per sync-skills docstring — candidate for the versioned control-plane's canonical deploy path.

disposition_clusters.sub_flavor: flatten transform (nested source dir -> flat deployed top-level)
disposition_clusters.evidence: deployed-MINUS-wt_top(top-level) = 55; 54 of 55 are exactly the names under skills/external/ (agentic-os, blueprint, claude-api, autonomous-loops, agent-* ...). The container name 'external' itself is NOT deployed (its contents are, flattened).
disposition_clusters.disposition_finding: The 53-strong 'mystery deployed-only' set is NOT orphans — it is the ECC/external pack sourced from skills/external/. Control-plane must model the nested->flat transform explicitly (a projection rule, not a 1:1 copy).

disposition_clusters.cluster: tc_top (192) vs wt_top (224) — same repo, two branches
disposition_clusters.sub_flavor: branch divergence (NOT independent repos); tc_top is a strict subset (tc MINUS wt = empty; wt MINUS tc = 32 held/ahead skills)
disposition_clusters.evidence: git worktree list; both are worktrees of one repo. The 32 are the reconcile-branch additions absent from feat/codex-fleet-github-wave2.
disposition_clusters.disposition_finding: No true fork conflict — a clean fast-forward relationship. Folds cleanly once branches reconcile (task #8 'Fold PR #78 -> toolchain mainline'). Not a duplicate to resolve; a branch to merge.

disposition_clusters.sub_flavor: DESIGN intent = intentional-scope-override (curated subset); REALITY = drifted fork (membership AND content)
disposition_clusters.evidence: daily is NOT a subset of deployed (22 daily-only) NOR of any repo source. Content drift: codex-consult daily!=deployed; of 9 shared samples 4 differ (reframe, tdd-workflow, deep-research, ui-audit) and 5 match (design-studio, frida, radare2, council, security-review) ~= 44% drift. wfmon/workflow-monitor is NOT in daily at all.
disposition_clusters.disposition_finding: DAILY IS THE MOST-DRIFTED, HIGHEST-RISK LANE and it is the one Claude actually loads. It diverges up (22 gems only-here, newer than repo) AND down (missing wfmon; behind main). If daily were ever regenerated from the vault, 22 live skills + local edits would be lost. The control-plane must make daily a DERIVED, regenerable view of a single source, or promote-then-project.

disposition_clusters.evidence: Present in ~/.claude/skills.daily; absent from deployed, wt_top, wt_external, skills-claude-only. These are the 2026-07-12 gem-hunt adoptions + recent additions. Source-of-truth unknown (hand-placed or plugin-derived).
disposition_clusters.disposition_finding: These live ONLY in the daily lane with NO backing repo. Highest source-of-truth risk in the whole skills surface. Each needs owner triage: back-port to skills/ (canonical) or confirm as plugin-provided.

disposition_clusters.evidence: On origin/main monitorcore exists at BOTH skills/workflow-monitor/monitorcore/*.py (12 modules: contract, discovery, export, monitors, pdf, redact, render_html, render_md, report_doc, agent_state, agent_tail, __init__) AND tools/monitorcore/ (tests/fixtures/monitors.toml). It is a Python PACKAGE, not a top-level skill dir (appears in NO skills lane). Byte-identity of the two homes NOT hashed (READ-ONLY, unmerged branch).
disposition_clusters.disposition_finding: monitorcore is infrastructure vendored inside the workflow-monitor skill AND duplicated under tools/. Which is canonical is UNRESOLVED. Not a skill for the skills matrix per se, but a duplication the control-plane must collapse to one home.

disposition_clusters.sub_flavor: clean deployed projection, but origin/main is AHEAD for the monitorcore subpackage
disposition_clusters.evidence: origin/main:skills contains BOTH (PR #71 CONFIRMED merged). Deployed SKILL.md hashes match the reconcile worktree. BUT deployed/worktree workflow-monitor LACKS monitorcore/ (main-ahead: is-ancestor(4b531cd #76, reconcile-HEAD dd5366b)=1). monitor-launcher skill (skills/monitor-launcher/mon.cmd+monitors.toml, PR-B2 #76) is NOT deployed, NOT in daily, NOT in the reconcile worktree.
disposition_clusters.disposition_finding: The merged monitoring stack (monitorcore pkg #75 + monitor-launcher + vendoring #76) exists ONLY on origin/main. Every LIVE lane runs the pre-#75/#76 workflow-monitor. Prior-art 'ride wfmon, already merged' is true for main but the LIVE box is behind. Re-deploy from main (or fold reconcile onto post-#76 main) before Axis-C rides wfmon.

disposition_clusters.evidence: Present in wt_top ONLY; absent from deployed AND daily AND tc_top (one of only 2 skills in wt_top-MINUS-deployed, the other being the 'external' container). Matches ingest-task9-codex-invoke: the scoped `codex exec` primitive deliberately not deployed pending fold.
disposition_clusters.disposition_finding: HELD BY DESIGN — the scoped-Codex-exec primitive (5 profiles, M0-M3 scoping, SUCCESS/FAILED contract, codex-doctor). Keystone cross-vendor lane for the control-plane (codexAgent() sibling of native agent()). Deploy only after the deploy/pin prerequisite (install.py --deploy-codex + codex_doctor -Pin -Live). Task #7.

disposition_clusters.evidence: Present in tc_top + deployed + wt_top (codex-invoke wt-only). Only codex-consult is surfaced in the daily lane. These are Codex-provider primitives, NOT duplicates of Claude skills.
disposition_clusters.disposition_finding: Legitimate provider adapters for the Codex first-class lane. In a 3-provider control-plane these are the Codex-lane peers of the Claude-lane skills; keep as a provider-scoped namespace, do NOT dedup against Claude skills.

disposition_clusters.evidence: .agents/generated/ holds per-provider CONFIG projections (Antigravity, Gemini, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Junie, OpenCode) + import-report provenance (skill-import-report-2026-04-01.tsv, mcp-import-report-2026-04-01.json). .agents/archive-manifests/ carries generation provenance (codex-agent-markdown.json, skill-description-normalization.json).
disposition_clusters.disposition_finding: This is the EXISTING seed of the cross-provider projection the program wants (all three first-class). Config not skills, but the direct precedent for a declarative source -> per-provider generated view. The control-plane should generalize .agents/generated into the versioned projection layer.

disposition_clusters.evidence: 13 metaswarm-* in skills-claude-only/ mirror the installed plugin at ~/.claude/plugins/metaswarm (+ cache/metaswarm-marketplace + data/metaswarm-inline, surfaced as metaswarm:X in the available-skills list). Mostly NOT deployed (5/36 claude-only deployed).
disposition_clusters.disposition_finding: Toolchain-local forks/shims of marketplace plugin skills, kept so the toolchain deploy can ship them independent of the marketplace. 3-way surface per skill: plugin (metaswarm:X) + claude-only fork (metaswarm-X) + sometimes a command (X.md). Dormant (mostly undeployed). Resolve to a single provider (plugin) OR keep as an intentional vendored copy — owner call.

disposition_clusters.sub_flavor: slash-command aliases over skills / ECC / metaswarm
disposition_clusters.evidence: 70 command .md files, NO repo source (neither worktree has commands/). Many names appear ALSO as skills (metaswarm:prime, metaswarm:self-reflect, grill-me-extensive skill) and/or plugin commands. Internal command dupes: start+start-task, setup+setup-pm, grill-me+grill-me-extensive+grill-with-docs, multi-{backend,execute,frontend,plan,workflow}, instinct-{export,import,status}, loop-{start,status}.
disposition_clusters.disposition_finding: Commands are a thin shim lane with no versioned source. The control-plane must decide command SSOT (currently hand-maintained live-only) and de-alias command<->skill<->plugin triplets.
